scope.input_mouth: cofinalSegment takes only type/group parameters and actual factory, initial, cfg, language, ordinal. No caller-selected native frame, completed future table, target commutes, positivity, terminal, coverage or disposition enters this producer.
scope.actual_segment: realizedSegment enriches original Admissions.actual_segment with a dependent Sigma payload. Original distance-zero Sum branch and full native packet, paid offsets and actual node witnesses are retained. realizedSegment_source proves exact erasure equality for every start.
scope.native_selection: selected is the localNativeReceipt stopping frame of the original AdmissionPacket at its own Lower W native.1 grade; selected_settled consumes that receipt's own settlement/action witnesses.
scope.born_environment: born is original Shared.nextBorn(selected,stockCfg(native.cfg)). native input Env, prebirth registered Env and decoded born active Env retain their distinct source indices. actual_born_updated_environment identifies the original updated residual input with that born.activeEnvironment; effect/residual/affine write are evaluated there.
scope.literal_boundary: actual_born_boundary remains the literal single registered expression minus single event residual expression. The affine write is boundary minus constantMap(valueMap born.activeEnvironment boundary); historical relation membership does not yield born Env zero.
scope.inverse: actual_born_inverse consumes original effectFaces.rangeEquiv at the generated paidCoordinate and identifies its value with the actual expression at born.activeEnvironment. The full inverse construction remains the already-paid original source, rather than an injected witness.
scope.local_arrow: bornBinding uses actual born activeEnvironment constants. Original SourceSubstitution.complexMorphism produces the backward complex arrow from born.activeEnvironment to born.registered.input.environment; neither binding nor commuting proofs are caller arguments.
scope.dependent_fibres: Local born Env complexes use actual Lower W grade. Full-State CP110 cofinalDiagram/source_span keep their independent Carrier. This candidate preserves both source-indexed fibres and does not prove their identity or an arbitrary physical projection arrow.
scope.independent_consumer: consumeCofinalSegment is original Sum.elim on generated cofinalSegment, with separate distance-zero and full dependent native handlers, Result : Sort v. The handlers are readout consumers and do not produce or certify a terminal.
scope.authority: No new Stage, root, controller, runtime or U7/U8 is introduced. This is a subordinate source/effect producer and same-r cofinal consumer of existing actual events; no controller advancement or global terminal is claimed.
scope.suggestions_index: Existing Lean.LibrarySuggestions.nameDenyListExt only excludes the generated namespace from suggestion retrieval/indexing. All new declarations still undergo focused kernel checking at trust0; no kernel escape or proof-body replacement was used.
